headline: Bitcoin hovers near $79.9k, testing a tight range as liquidity dries
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming a descending channel with higher lows; the 4H shows a flat range between ~79,500 and ~80,200, holding the $79,800 pivot as a liquidity sink.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta DeFi tokens, with RAY, ORCA and METIS leading the rally, indicating risk‑on sentiment beyond Bitcoin.
strategy_outlook: Spot: stay flat, consider buying on dips to $79,500 with tight stops; Futures: sell‑stop orders near $80,200 to capture short‑term upside volatility.
